Grade Components

•  Quiz: 5 points (average of the best N-1               scores)
•  Lab attendance and exercise: 5 points (average of the best N-1                         scores)
•  Interview: 20 points        (before the end of Week 16)
   •  Level 1 (5 points): Development tools (Linux command line, gcc, g++, make, CMake, etc.)
   •  Level 2 (5 points): Pointers and memory management
   •  Level 3 (5 points): Pixel-based image processing
   •  Level 4 (5 points): Basic contributions to OpenCV
   •  Level 5  (A+): Excellent contributions to OpenCV
•  Project: 50 points
   •  ~5 projects, some are easy projects
   •  Grading standard (via code and report-based interview):
         •  90-100: Complete all tasks almost perfectly
         •  80-90: Complete all tasks well
         •  70-80: Complete all tasks
•  Final exam: 30 points
